alkylation_concentration.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 1 mM dithiothreitol for 30 min followed by alkylation with 5.5 mM iodoacetamide for 15 min in the dark.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 1 mM dithiothreitol for 30 min followed by alkylation with 5.5 mM iodoacetamide for 15 min in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were digested directly off the beads with a trypsin-Lys C solution overnight at 37°C with shaking at 300 rpm.

collision_energy.evidence: Peptides were fragmented by HCD with a precursor isolation window of 1.6 m/z, maximum injection time of 50 ms, and collision energy of 35%.

enrichment_method.value: biotin conjugated R391me0 or R391me2s peptides and 20 μl of Streptavidin C1 beads
enrichment_method.evidence: 25 μg of biotin conjugated R391me0 or R391me2s peptides and 20 μl of Streptavidin C1 beads were incubated in 300 μL binding buffer (see peptide pull-down assay) overnight at 4 °C.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Peptides were fragmented by HCD with a precursor isolation window of 1.6 m/z, maximum injection time of 50 ms, and collision energy of 35%.

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Peptides were analyzed by LC-MS/MS with an EASY nLC 1200 in-line with an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Mass Spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).

ptm.evidence: Search parameters permitted two missed cleavages, a minimum peptide length of seven amino acids, fixed cysteine carbamidomethylation, and variable protein N-terminal acetylation and methionine oxidation.
